programme.title: Chennaieil Oru Naal
programme.desc: A star, a police officer, and a journalist become involved in a major event at a traffic signal. When the journalist is hit by a car and declared brain dead, the star asks for the journalist's heart for his sick daughter.

programme.title: Bloody Beggar
programme.desc: A lazy beggar finds himself in trouble when a misadventure turns his life upside down. He gets caught amidst the activities of crooked individuals who want to use his life as bait to achieve what they want.

programme.title: Peranmai
programme.desc: Dhuruvan is a forest ranger, who is assigned the job of training five girls from the NCC camp. The group hears of a terrorist activity being carried out in the forest and makes a plan to defeat them.

programme.title: Gulebagavali
programme.desc: Badri, a thief, tries to steal a mysterious trunk from a village, Gulaebagavali, as per the orders of a businessman. However, chaos ensues when the truth about the trunk is revealed.

programme.title: Mr. Local
programme.desc: Manohar constantly finds himself in a tussle with Keerthana, an egoistical woman, but eventually falls in love with her. However, she is far from thinking that he is good enough for her.

programme.title: Mouna Guru
programme.desc: Karunakaran is an intelligent youth who cannot tolerate injustice. He leaves his home town and joins a college in Chennai, but soon gets involved with a group of corrupt policemen.

programme.title: Movie Contd - Mouna Guru

programme.title: Pudhu Kudithanam
programme.desc: Ashok is a very obedient son and his mother would like an equally submissive daughter-in-law so that she does not influence him. But Ashok secretly marries Nila, who actually dislikes this situation.

programme.title: Krishna Krishnaa
programme.desc: Gopalakrishnan, an innocent young man, struggles to reconcile his cunning mother and Bama, his morally upright wife. However, when she suspects him of having bad habits, she decides to leave him.

programme.title: Kanagavel Kaaka
programme.desc: A court employee, son of an honest judge treated wrongly, takes it upon himself to clean up the judicial system.

programme.title: Captain
programme.desc: Kannayiram, a powerful gangster, kills Ramasamy, for not giving up his land to him. After hearing this news, Shiva, Ramasamy's brother, flees the military camp to avenge his brother's death.

programme.title: Mitta Mirasu

programme.title: Kannethire Thondrinaal

programme.title: Anwar
programme.desc: Anwar, a middle-class Muslim, falls in love with Mehru, a Hindu girl. Post her death, he is caught by the police and a misunderstanding leads them to believe that he is a terrorist.
